title: authenticator: sort candidates by common path segments instead of prefixes
body:
This fixes an issue where the wrong credentials were sent when two repositories with the same netloc were configured and the last path segment of the second one starts with the last path segment of the first one.

Further, `commonprefix` is deprecated with Python 3.15.
